items.name: DataTypeCompat
items.summary: Capture the compatibility between two data-types, as passed to [`ensure_data_types`]

items.name: ValidationMode
items.summary: Controls how `ensure_data_types` validates struct fields and metadata.

items.name: ensure_data_types
items.signature: fn ensure_data_types(kernel_type: &schema::DataType, arrow_type: &arrow::datatypes::DataType, mode: ValidationMode) -> DeltaResult<DataTypeCompat>
items.summary: Ensure a kernel data type matches an arrow data type. This only ensures that the actual "type" is the same, but does so recursively into structs, and ensures lists and maps have the correct associated types as well.
